A LITTLE QUIET GOES A LONG WAY

Your study room
in Sonbersa.

Whether you’re preparing for an exam or making time for everyday learning, having a place to focus makes all the difference.

Our library is at Ward No. 4, Sonbersa Chowk, Musapur, Samastipur, near Shamb Siva Vivah Bhawan. Individual study desks and a quiet setting give you room to build a routine. Visit any day between 6 AM and 10 PM to see the space and ask about available seats.
